Durable electro-plated black finish for exceptional corrosion resistance
Compatible with ZF-5, ZF-5P, ZF-5K, MP5, SP5, HK94, MP5K, SP5K, SP89, MP5SD, and other 9mm roller-delayed blowback firearms
All steel construction
Round count indicator holes on the rear of the magazine
Stainless steel follower
Reinforced feed lips
High-tensile compression spring
